title: Run the design-system suite as a separate parallel CI job (decision D18)
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Hosted Foundation run 39461681606 on pull request #3 (3997557) failed: ci:verify hit its 900 s limit during the in-pipeline design-system-browser stage after about 826 s of existing stages (foundation 240 s, live-matches 343 s, browser 186 s). Director decision D18: run the design-system suite as a separate parallel CI job.

scripts/ci/design-system.mjs (pnpm ci:design-system) asserts isolation and runs the design-system gates, the pinned Chromium install and the Storybook/Playwright/axe suite. scripts/ci-local.py gains --suite design-system, reusing the isolated copy, image, Compose project, credential checks and cleanup; that suite publishes host.json only and refuses the foundation upload directory. The workflow adds a parallel design-system job; scripts/ci/check-config.py validates both jobs; the foundation pipeline drops the design-system-browser stage (14 stages, unchanged budget).

tests/ci/launcher.test.py adds the design-system suite success path, the upload refusal and five workflow mutations (12 tests). RUN-20261020-032 (isolated design-system suite) passed before a final-message fix; RUN-20261020-033 (configuration and workflow checks, typecheck, lint, full suite: 399 Node, 26 Python, upstream 406/1 skip, 2 injection) and RUN-20261020-034 (isolated design-system suite: 30 gates, Chromium install, 150/150) pass at fingerprint 44591181. RUN-20261020-035 failed at docs:check because the verified features had not yet been re-bound to the new fingerprint.
RUN-20261020-036: isolated foundation pipeline passed all 14 stages in 539 s (484 Node, 26 Python, upstream 406/1 skip, 2 injection, 13 web Chromium, Lab workers).
